hypotheses.description: StreamingResponse.__call__ (the streaming path shown by _StreamingResponse in E3) hardcodes 'http.response.start' and 'http.response.body' rather than applying the 'websocket.' prefix that Response.__call__ applies for websocket scopes (E2). WebSocket.send_denial_response passes the websocket scope and WebSocket.send wrapper directly to the response (E1), so WebSocket.send rejects the un-prefixed messages with RuntimeError. The TestClient denial-response path confirms the required message types are websocket.http.response.start/body (E7).

hypotheses.description: In typer/core.py, TyperOption.value_from_envvar overrides Click's Parameter.value_from_envvar but fails to return the resolved environment variable: it computes rv = self.resolve_envvar_value(ctx), returns None only when rv is None, and then ends without returning rv. Consequently Click receives None from value_from_envvar and treats the envvar as unset for options, while Argument envvars (which do not go through this broken override) still work. This directly explains the reported typer==0.26.0 regression for typer.Option(envvar=...).
hypotheses.validation_step: Non-mutating inspection: construct a Click context with the envvar ME set, call TyperOption.value_from_envvar(ctx) on an option configured with envvar='ME', and observe that the method returns None instead of the envvar value.
